1
Sajday Se Joon Sar Uthaya Madah Ki Sajjad Ki.
Tab Howa Razi Khuda Our Khoob Phir Imdad Ki.
Qaid Kar Laye Sitam Zanjeer Mein Kuch Iss Tarha.
Sabar Mein Aayi Nazar Tasveer Youn Ajdad Ki.

2
Aap Ke Dam Se Howa Maula Ujala Chaar So.
Roshni Tareek Se Hai Aap Ne Aazad Ki.
Hosla Aisa Sakhi Ke Dar Se Hai Hum Ko Mila.
Hum Gareebon Ne Faqat Hai Inn Ke Haan Faryad Ki.

3
Iss Zameen Ke Bhag Jagay Aa Gaye Maula Marey.
Veraan Basti Naqsh-e-Pa Ki Shan Se Aabad Ki.
Mangtay Hain Har Dua Mein Bas Khuda Se Hum Yehi.
Nokari De Bas Muhammad Inn Ki Hi Aoulad Ki.

4
Door They Jo Aal Se Marey Hoye Woh Bugz Ke.
Unn Ki Maa Ki Ik Khata Ne Nasal Hai Barbad Ki.
Syeda Ki Hai Atta Zeeshan Warna Hum Bhala.
Likh Sakein Kab Martaba Our Manqabat Sajjad Ki.

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/sajday-se-joon-sar-uthaya-madah-ki-sajjad-ki-tajpoints-005b5e1071aecddcb9ef.md'
_, meta, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:'+p], text=True).split('---', 2)[2]
def lines(s):
    return [line.strip().rstrip('.').casefold() for line in s.splitlines() if line.strip()]
assert lines(roman) == lines(original)
for edition, numerals in [(roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')]:
    stanzas = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(stanzas) == 4
    for stanza, numeral in zip(stanzas, numerals):
        entries = lines(stanza)
        assert entries[0] == numeral and len(entries) == 5
print('Verified four matching stanzas and all 16 original Roman verses.')
PY"

from pathlib import Path
p = 'src/data/lyrics/sajday-se-joon-sar-uthaya-madah-ki-sajjad-ki-tajpoints-005b5e1071aecddcb9ef.md'
_, meta, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for edition, numerals in [(roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')]:
    blocks = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 4
    for block, number in zip(blocks, numerals):
        number_line, *verses = block.splitlines()
        assert number_line.strip() == number and len(verses) == 4
        assert all(verse.strip() and not verse.endswith('.') for verse in verses)
assert all(line.startswith('  ') for line in roman.splitlines() if line)
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified four matching stanzas of four verses each.')

Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions have four matching stanzas. Updated the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, retained the Roman alternate title, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read “Marey” as میرے in “Maula marey” and مارے in “marey hoye.”
